experience.title: P4 Director

experience.title: Consultant
experience.description: Developed and deployed a microservices-based application on AWS utilizing a Kubernetes cluster, ensuring scalability and high availability. Engineered a suite of reusable Angular Ul components, enhancing development efficiency and consistency, and delivered new features in an Agile environment. Optimized frontend performance through targeted code refactoring, rigorous testing, and refined state management, resulting in a 15% reduction in average load times. Designed and implemented RESTful microservices for backend communication, ensuring seamless data exchange between services and the Ul. Architected and deployed an end-to-end upstream application on serverless AWS infrastructure, streamlining data processing and reducing operational costs.

experience.title: Consultant

Developed a highly dynamic and client-configurable frontend UI, enabling seamless customization and improved user experience for diverse client needs. Engineered robust REST APIs using AWS Lambda and API Gateway, implementing comprehensive CloudWatch logging to facilitate efficient support and troubleshooting. Drove full lifecycle ownership of the application, encompassing development, performance optimization, and automated deployment, resulting in a 20% reduction in deployment time.

experience.title: Developer 1
